llm.summary: This is a plain mortgage compliance checklist with no executable code or hidden system access.

dimensions.detail: The skill’s stated purpose is TRID timeline review, and the artifact content stays within disclosure timing, re-disclosure triggers, tolerance checks, recordkeeping reminders, and red flags.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Activation and non-activation conditions are clearly scoped to mortgage application and closing timeline questions; no prompt overrides, hidden commands, or unrelated agent instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a single markdown SKILL.md file and no scripts, binaries, dependency installs, or runtime hooks.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may involve sensitive mortgage file facts when users apply it, but the artifact does not request broad local access, credentials, network calls, or automated data collection.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It advises retaining LE/CD timing evidence as part of compliance practice, but it does not implement persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, or file mutation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install for checklist-style mortgage timeline support. Users should treat it as compliance guidance rather than legal advice, verify current CFPB and Regulation Z/X rules, and avoid sharing unnecessary borrower personal or financial data with any agent using the skill.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: Reported no issues; manual artifact review supports the clean result.
[staticScan] expected: Reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the markdown-only checklist.
[VirusTotal] expected: Telemetry was clean and does not conflict with the artifact evidence.
